data.name: Onboarding_Welcome_Body
data.value: Parlotype spremeni govor v besedilo kjer koli v računalniku: narekujte v poljubno aplikacijo, prepoznano besedilo pa se vtipka natanko tam, kjer je kazalec. Privzeto razpoznavanje poteka v celoti v tem računalniku – zvok ga ne zapusti, razen če se namenoma preklopite na oblačni mehanizem.

data.name: Onboarding_Recording_Body
data.value: Pritisnite eno od svojih bližnjic za narekovanje ali kliknite označeni gumb za snemanje na pripomočku. Ko končate govoriti, se prepoznano besedilo vtipka v aplikacijo, ki ste jo nazadnje uporabljali. Vaše bližnjice:

data.name: Onboarding_Recording_EscLine
data.value: Esc – prekliče trenutno snemanje, ne da bi se karkoli vtipkalo

data.name: Onboarding_Hotkeys_None
data.value: Bližnjica za narekovanje ni nastavljena – uporabite gumb za snemanje na pripomočku ali dodajte bližnjico v Nastavitve → Bližnjice.

data.name: Onboarding_Widget_Body
data.value: To majhno okno, ki je vedno na vrhu, je vaše upravljanje narekovanja. Veliki gumb začne in ustavi snemanje; z miško postojte nad kartico, da vidite trenutno stanje. Povlecite ročico na vrhu, da okno premaknete kamor koli, gumb ✕ pa ga skrije v sistemsko vrstico. Mehanizmi, ki ponujajo izbiro jezika, prikažejo jezikovni trak na dnu.

data.name: Onboarding_Engine_Body
data.value: Parlotype vključuje več mehanizmov za razpoznavanje – med njimi preklapljajte v označenem seznamu. Parakeet v3 je privzet: hiter, deluje v celoti na napravi in samodejno zazna 25 evropskih jezikov. Vsak mehanizem doda svoje strani v meni na levi.

data.name: Onboarding_Model_Body
data.value: Vsak lokalni mehanizem ponuja modele različnih velikosti – večji modeli so natančnejši, a počasnejši in zahtevajo več prostora na disku. Datoteke modelov se samodejno prenesejo ob prvi uporabi; modeli, ki so že na disku, so v seznamu označeni.

data.name: Onboarding_Cloud_Body
data.value: Oba oblačna mehanizma sta privzeto izklopljena in zahtevata lasten ključ API. Ko je eden od njiju aktiven, se vaš zvok pošlje temu ponudniku za prepis, pripomoček pa prikazuje stalno oznako Oblak. Vse drugo v Parlotype ostane povsem lokalno.

data.name: Onboarding_Tray_Body
data.value:
Skritje ali zapiranje pripomočka ne zapre Parlotype – ta še naprej posluša vaše bližnjice iz sistemske vrstice. Kliknite ikono v sistemski vrstici, da pripomoček znova prikažete. Če želite Parlotype popolnoma zapreti, z desno tipko miške kliknite ikono v sistemski vrstici in izberite Izhod.
Da bližnjica deluje takoj po prijavi, se Parlotype zažene skupaj z Windows in čaka v sistemski vrstici – nobeno okno se ne odpre. To lahko kadar koli izklopite v Nastavitve → Aplikacija → Zagon.

data.name: Onboarding_Recap_Body
data.value: Narekujte kjer koli z bližnjicami ali gumbom na pripomočku. Mehanizmi, modeli, bližnjice in jeziki so v Nastavitvah – ta vodnik in pregled bližnjic pa sta vedno na voljo pod Nastavitve → Pomoč.

data.name: Help_Intro
data.value: Ste novi v Parlotype? Vodeni vodnik vas popelje skozi snemanje, pripomoček, mehanizme in modele – odpre vsak zaslon in sproti označi kontrolnike.

data.comment: "HKCU Run" is a registry path — never translated.
data.value: En sam vnos pod vašim uporabniškim računom (HKCU Run), ki kaže na Parlotype. Brez storitve, brez načrtovanega opravila, brez skrbniških pravic, nič, kar bi veljalo za celoten računalnik. Vnos si lahko ogledate in odstranite tudi sami v Upravitelju opravil → Zagon.

data.value: Samo, kadar veljajo vsi trije pogoji: stikalo Prevod je vklopljeno, izbran je izhodni jezik in ta se razlikuje od izgovorjenega (Samodejno zaznaj se vedno šteje kot različen). V nasprotnem primeru mehanizem samo prepisuje, izhodni jezik pa je enak izgovorjenemu.

data.name: Settings_Prompts_Help_BuiltInBody
data.comment: {speech_lang} and {text_lang} are literal placeholder tokens the user types into a prompt — never translate them, and keep the braces exactly.

data.comment: Fallback for a llama-server build whose backend could not be identified. Every other backend name (CPU, CUDA, Vulkan, ROCm / HIP, SYCL, Metal, KleidiAI) is an identifier and stays as it is.

data.name: Settings_Language_Description
data.value: En odnos, ki ga berete od leve proti desni: govorite izvorni jezik, Parlotype natipka ciljni jezik. Povezovalni element med njima vklopi in izklopi prevajanje.

data.name: Settings_Language_PausedSubLine
data.comment: Sits beside the translation switch, which stays on and operable (ADR-061). Keep it short.
data.value: Zaustavljeno – ta model ne zna prevajati

data.name: Language_ChooseTranslatingModel
data.comment: One button, two surfaces — the Language page and the Transcribe flyout (ADR-061). They must not drift, hence one key.

data.name: Language_Picker_NoResultsFormat
data.comment: {0} is whatever the user typed into the search box.
data.value: Noben jezik se ne ujema z „{0}“.

data.name: Language_Connector_PausedTooltipFormat
data.comment: {0} is a Whisper model name such as "Large v3 Turbo" — never translated.

data.name: Language_ToggleSwitch_TranslateToFormat
data.comment: {0} is a language name. NOTE: once phase 6 localizes language names, this slot needs a case other than nominative in Russian — see the plan's "language-name cases" note.

data.name: Language_ToggleSwitch_Translate
data.comment: Fallback label when the engine has no fixed translation target to name.

data.name: Language_UnavailableNoteFormat
data.comment: {0} is an engine name ("Whisper", "Gemma 4", "Parakeet") — never translated, and it leads the sentence.
data.value: {0} ne zna prevajati – Parlotype natipka natanko to, kar poveste.

data.name: Language_Source_DetectedFormat
data.comment: {0} is the detected keyboard layout's friendly name. The colon keeps {0} in a position that needs no grammatical case.

data.name: Language_Source_LayoutUnavailable
data.value: Zaznavanje postavitve ni na voljo – namesto tega poteka samodejno zaznavanje

data.name: Language_Target_SameAsSource
data.comment: Target card while translation is off — the output matches the spoken language.

data.name: Language_Summary_Format
data.comment: {0} is the spoken language, {1} what gets typed. Both are language names, so keep each one where it needs no grammatical case — after a colon or dash rather than after a preposition.

data.name: Language_Summary_YourKeyboardLanguage
data.comment: Substituted as {0} of Language_Summary_Format when the source follows the keyboard layout but it could not be resolved.

data.name: Language_Summary_AnyLanguage
data.comment: Substituted as {0} of Language_Summary_Format when the engine auto-detects.

data.name: Language_Summary_TranslationPausedFormat
data.comment: {0} is the spoken language. The result is substituted as {1} of Language_Summary_Format.

data.name: Language_Summary_NoTranslationFormat
data.comment: {0} is the spoken language. The result is substituted as {1} of Language_Summary_Format.

data.name: Language_TranslationPausedNoteFormat
data.comment: {0} is a Whisper model name — never translated. "Medium" and "Large v1/v2/v3" are model names too.
data.value: Prevajanje je zaustavljeno – „{0}“ omogoča samo prepisovanje. Za nadaljevanje izberite Medium ali Large v1/v2/v3.

data.name: Language_Toast_SourceUnsupportedFormat
data.comment: {0} is a language name and leads the sentence; {1} is an engine name, never translated.
data.value: Jezik {0} ni podprt kot izvorni v mehanizmu: {1}. Uporabljena bo postavitev tipkovnice.

data.name: Language_Toast_EngineCannotTranslateFormat
data.comment: {0} is an engine name — never translated, and it leads the sentence.
data.value: {0} ne zna prevajati – izhod zdaj ustreza izgovorjenemu jeziku.

data.name: Language_Toast_TargetUnsupportedFormat
data.comment: {0} is the language that was dropped, {1} the engine name, {2} the language it fell back to. Keep {2} after a dash or colon so it needs no grammatical case.
data.value: Jezik {0} ni na voljo v mehanizmu: {1}. Jezik prevoda: {2}.

data.name: Language_Toast_TargetResetFormat
data.comment: {0} is an engine name — never translated.
data.value: Prejšnji ciljni jezik je bil ponastavljen – mehanizem {0} ga ne podpira.

data.name: Language_Toast_ModelPausedFormat
data.comment: {0} is a Whisper model name — never translated.
data.value: „{0}“ ne zna prevajati – prevajanje je zaustavljeno, dokler ne izberete večjezičnega modela.

data.name: Settings_CloudProviders_Intro
data.comment: ADR-032's positioning line is quoted verbatim at the end — keep "Local by default. Cloud by choice." recognisable, and keep the ADR reference.
data.value: Uporabite lasten ključ API. Ko je oblačni mehanizem aktiven, se vaši zvočni posnetki pošljejo nastavljenemu ponudniku za prepis – za ta mehanizem nič ne teče lokalno. Obračunavanje poteka neposredno med vami in ponudnikom; Parlotype ni posrednik pri obračunavanju (ADR-032, „Local by default. Cloud by choice.“).

data.name: Settings_Engine_Gemma4SectionNote
data.comment: "Gemma 4 E4B", "llama-server", "llama.cpp" and "Vulkan" are identifiers — never translated.
data.value: Gemma 4 E4B teče prek lokalnega procesa llama-server (llama.cpp, Vulkan). Samo prepisovanje v angleščino. Najbolje deluje s čistim govorom in dobrim mikrofonom. Datoteke modela (~10 GB) se prenesejo ob prvi uporabi.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Gesture_HoldFormat
data.comment: {0} is a key name such as "Right Ctrl" — key names stay as they are printed on the keyboard, in every language.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Gesture_DoubleTapFormat
data.comment: {0} is a key name such as "Ctrl" — key names stay as they are printed on the keyboard, in every language.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Mode_PushToTalk
data.comment: Badge on a hotkey row: hold the key to talk, release to stop.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Mode_Toggle
data.comment: Badge on a hotkey row: press once to start, again to stop.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_LineFormat
data.comment: {0} is the gesture ("Hold Right Ctrl"), {1} its mode ("Push to talk"). Used in the Help page and the first-run tour.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Modifier_LeftFormat
data.comment: {0} is a key name such as "Ctrl" — never translated. Word order is free: English puts the side first, Spanish puts it last.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Modifier_RightFormat
data.comment: {0} is a key name such as "Ctrl" — never translated. Word order is free: English puts the side first, Spanish puts it last.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_Invalid
data.comment: Shown when the recorded gesture cannot be combined with its activation mode at all.
data.value: Te kombinacije ni mogoče uporabiti kot bližnjico za narekovanje.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_AlreadyBoundFormat
data.comment: {0} is the gesture ("Hold Right Ctrl"), {1} the mode it is already bound to (Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_Mode_*). Each language decides how the mode reads inside the sentence, which is why those are separate keys from the badge labels.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_Mode_PushToTalk
data.comment: Push-to-talk as it reads inside Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_AlreadyBoundFormat (English wants it lowercase mid-sentence; Russian quotes it, so it stays capitalized).

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_Mode_Toggle
data.comment: Toggle mode as it reads inside Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_AlreadyBoundFormat.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_ReservedFormat
data.comment: {0} is the chord ("Win+L") — never translated; {1} is what the system does with it (Settings_Hotkeys_Reserved_*).

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_ParameterHintsFormat
data.comment: {0} is the chord. "Visual Studio" and "VS Code" are product names — do not translate them.
data.value: {0} v Visual Studiu in VS Code prikaže namige za parametre.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Conflict_AltGrFormat
data.comment: {0} is the chord. "AltGr", "Ctrl", "Alt" and "Space" are key names — never translated.
data.value: Na evropskih postavitvah tipkovnice AltGr deluje kot Ctrl+Alt, zato lahko {0} sproži med tipkanjem naglašenih znakov. Ctrl+Alt+Space se temu izogne.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Reserved_LockWorkstation
data.comment: What Windows or macOS does with a shortcut Parlotype refuses to take over. These are OS feature names — use the wording the user's own operating system uses, not a literal translation of the English.

data.name: Settings_Hotkeys_Reserved_VoiceTyping
data.value: Glasovno tipkanje Windows; na macOS in GNOME skrije okno

data.name: Cloud_ProviderName_OpenAiCompatible
data.comment: Names the provider inside error messages. Every Cloud_* format below puts this slot first, followed by a colon or a verb, so the name is always nominative and no language needs to inflect it. "OpenAI" is a product name — do not translate it.

data.name: Cloud_ProviderName_XaiGrok
data.comment: Product name — identical in every language.

data.name: Cloud_NotConfigured_MissingKeyFormat
data.comment: {0} is the provider name (Cloud_ProviderName_*).
data.value: {0}: ni nastavljenega ključa API. Dodajte ga v Nastavitve → Govorni mehanizem.

data.name: Cloud_NotConfigured_InvalidBaseUrlFormat
data.comment: {0} is the provider name, {1} the reason the URL was refused (Cloud_BaseUrl_*).
data.value: {0}: osnovni URL je zavrnjen ({1}). Popravite ga v Nastavitve → Govorni mehanizem.

data.name: Cloud_BaseUrl_NotAbsolute
data.comment: A sentence fragment: it is shown on its own under the base-URL field, and also embedded in Cloud_NotConfigured_InvalidBaseUrlFormat.

data.name: Cloud_BaseUrl_PlainHttp
data.comment: See Cloud_BaseUrl_NotAbsolute. "http", "https" and "localhost" are literals.
data.value: navadni http je dovoljen samo za localhost – ključ API in zvok bi ta računalnik zapustila nešifrirano

data.name: Cloud_BaseUrl_UnsupportedSchemeFormat
data.comment: {0} is the URL scheme the user typed ("ftp", "file"). See Cloud_BaseUrl_NotAbsolute.

data.name: Cloud_Error_KeyRejectedFormat
data.comment: {0} is the provider name, {1} the HTTP status, {2} the provider's own error text (arrives already written, in whatever language the provider chose).
data.value: {0}: ključ API je bil zavrnjen (HTTP {1}). {2} Preverite ključ v Nastavitve → Govorni mehanizem.

data.name: Cloud_Error_QuotaExceededFormat
data.comment: {0} is the provider name, {1} the provider's own error text.
data.value: {0}: presežena kvota API – preverite svoj načrt in obračunavanje pri ponudniku. ({1})

data.name: Cloud_Error_RateLimitedFormat
data.comment: {0} is the provider name, {1} the provider's own error text.
data.value: {0}: dosežena omejitev hitrosti – počakajte trenutek in poskusite znova. ({1})

data.name: Cloud_Error_ProviderUnavailableFormat
data.comment: {0} is the provider name, {1} the HTTP status, {2} the provider's own error text.
data.value: {0} trenutno ne deluje (HTTP {1}) – poskusite znova čez nekaj časa. ({2})

data.name: Cloud_Error_OtherFormat
data.comment: {0} is the provider name, {1} the HTTP status, {2} the provider's own error text.

data.name: Language_Picker_RecentGroup
data.comment: Non-interactive group header above the MRU cluster in a language picker popover (Settings -> Language and the Transcribe flyout share this).

data.name: Language_Picker_AllLanguagesGroup
data.comment: Non-interactive group header above the full catalog in a language picker popover, shown only once the list is long enough to need Recent/All grouping (see LanguageRowFactory.SearchThreshold).

data.name: Language_Target_TranslationHint
data.comment: Sub-hint under the Settings -> Language page's full-form target field while translation is on. Parallels Language_Source_SpokenLanguageHint.

data.name: Hotkey_Hint_None
data.comment: Record-button tooltip and onboarding recap line, shown when no dictation hotkey is configured. Short — this sits in a tooltip, unlike the longer Onboarding_Hotkeys_None banner.

data.name: Hotkey_Hint_TalkFormat
data.comment: {0} is the already-localized gesture ("Hold Right Ctrl", "Ctrl+Alt+Space") for a push-to-talk binding — hold it, talk, release it.

data.name: Hotkey_Hint_DictateFormat
data.comment: Same as Hotkey_Hint_TalkFormat, for a toggle binding (press once to start, again to stop) — there is no key to hold, so "talk" would be misleading.

data.name: Hotkey_Hint_WithCancelFormat
data.comment: {0} is the result of Hotkey_Hint_TalkFormat/DictateFormat. "Esc" is a key name — use whatever that key is called on a keyboard in this language, usually "Esc".

data.name: Settings_LlamaCpp_ManualFolderPlaceholder
data.value: Mapa ni izbrana – izberite mapo z datoteko llama-server.exe

data.name: Settings_LlamaCpp_ManualFolderRequiredError

data.name: Settings_LlamaCpp_PackFolderWarningHeading

data.comment: Label before the Parlotype install folder path shown in the pack-folder warning. Distinct from Settings_LlamaCpp_PathLabel, which labels a llama-server or model path.
